# The Room by Kencho Group

> Kencho Group makes custom kitchens, wardrobes and furniture, made to measure
> in its own workshop in Tbilisi, Georgia. This page (room.kenchogroup.ge) is
> its showcase; the company's full site is https://www.kenchogroup.ge.

## What the page is

- A short narrated opening in kinetic type, then one page:
  "Furniture drawn for your walls."
- What we do: we measure your room, draw every millimetre, build it in our own
  workshop in Tbilisi and fit it ourselves.
- What we make: kitchens; wardrobes; media walls; shelving; bedrooms and kids
  rooms; offices.
- Palettes: five kitchen palettes to start from (beige white and black quartz;
  sage and oak; forest green with walnut and marble; warm white with honey oak
  and travertine; greige with graphite).
- The footer is a hand-drawn 3D room: try the palette on its kitchen, look at
  it from every side, see kitchens Kencho Group built, and book a meeting.
